environment.npm_audit_summary: 31 vulnerabilities reported by npm audit (2 low, 8 moderate, 19 high, 2 critical); not resolved in this verification pass

individual_tests.name: Scenario Lifecycle
individual_tests.evidence: Full scenario lifecycle integration test passed successfully

evidence_validation.scope: application-level evidence admission and telemetry integrity checks
evidence_validation.evidence: Evidence admission tests passed and rejected spoofed, duplicate, malformed, cross-user, and invalid payloads

scoring.evidence: Scoring engine and objective gate checks passed in unit tests

replay.evidence: Replay engine detected changed evidence and rule-version drift while passing all 7 replay tests

persistence.evidence: Scenario lifecycle and concurrency tests verified SQLite persistence, rollback, and replay integrity

concurrency.evidence: 7/7 concurrency tests passed with temporary file-backed SQLite

dashboard.evidence: Evidence dashboard model tests passed 5/5 across pass, fail, missing, invalid, and failed-reset payload states

startup.notes: No live scenario health checks, reset, residue detection, or containment tests were executed after startup failure

health_checks.reason: Docker services did not start successfully

real_reset.reason: Startup failed before a live reset could be evaluated

residue_detection.reason: No live running lab was available to inspect

network_containment.reason: Docker services never reached a running state; runtime containment tests are blocked

documentation_consistency_check.result: Occurrences were checked against actual evidence. Claims that were unsupported or stale were removed or qualified; live Docker and containment claims remain explicitly marked as not executed/not verified.
notable_findings: The repository no longer states unsupported full-isolation claims in the main documentation or evidence files.
The Docker lab config comments were corrected to avoid overstating runtime containment.
Historical results files remain accurate to their recorded run and are not treated as unexecuted evidence.

remaining_blockers: Live Docker startup failed during build: missing file ./appdata/openplc.db in the OilSprings lab config, so real scenario startup, health validation, reset, residue detection, and network containment could not complete.
Because startup did not complete, the project is not yet submission-ready for live deployment or live containment claims.
npm audit reported 31 vulnerabilities; this was not remediated in this verification phase and should be reviewed separately before production-facing deployment.
